Eva bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. At first, Eva found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. What's more, these hardy flowers survive even the coldest mountain winters.

Eva prefers snowy weather when running in the cinema. Anna advised Eva to try dancing as a new hobby. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, the castle is built on a huge rock.

On Friday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, an aphid colony swarms the rose tips.
Eva thanked Anna for the honest advice. The city park looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Microplastic turned up in table salt.
The experience taught Eva more than any book could. The river bank has become an important part of daily life. Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
